interface.longDescription: Kit Viagem helps Brazilian travelers prepare an international trip: it checks whether travel insurance is mandatory at a destination, compares reference prices of travel insurance plans in BRL, and ranks accounts and cards by estimated cost abroad (IOF, spread and fees). Data comes from official sites with the check date shown. Content in Portuguese (pt-BR). Read-only, no login, never issues policies, exchanges money or stores personal data. Some links are affiliate links and Kit Viagem may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
defaultPrompt: Do I need travel insurance for Portugal? Which is the cheapest?
Which card or account costs less to spend USD 2,000 in the US?
Which travel insurance fits a 72-year-old going to Argentina?

positive.prompt: Do I need travel insurance for Portugal? Which is the cheapest?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Portugal entry rules, cheapest insurance options in BRL with reference-quote note and links.

positive.prompt: Which travel insurance fits a 72-year-old going to Argentina?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Argentina rules and insurance options considering age 72.

positive.prompt: Which card or account costs less to spend USD 2,000 in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns ranking of accounts/cards by estimated cost (IOF, spread, fees).

positive.prompt: Compare Wise and Nomad for travel spending.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches both products and returns a side-by-side comparison.

positive.prompt: What categories and destinations do you cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns categories, use cases and destinations.

negative.prompt: Issue a travel insurance policy for me now.
What is the weather in Rome next week?
